description: Address v2 review findings: SharePointSetupController command injection validation, wire useServerContext into route pages, GetPartnerships error handling, and fix SignalR handler accumulation.
steps: Add input validation to SharePointSetupController ExecuteSetup for all user-supplied fields (FileSharePath, FileShareUrl, SqlDownloadUrl, SqlTargetServer, SqlInstanceName, SqlDisk, SpServers) using regex allowlist patterns
Update performance.tsx to use useServerContext() for initial server value and sync changes back to shared context
Update storage-replica.tsx to use useServerContext() for initial server value and sync changes back to shared context
Change StorageReplicaController GetPartnerships catch block from Ok(empty) to StatusCode(500, error message)
Move SignalR lifecycle handler registration (onreconnecting, onreconnected, onclose) from useSignalR hook to getSignalRConnection so they are registered once per connection
acceptance_criteria: SharePointSetupController validates all interpolated user inputs against regex patterns before building scripts
performance.tsx uses useServerContext() and syncs server selection to/from shared context
storage-replica.tsx uses useServerContext() and syncs server selection to/from shared context
GetPartnerships returns StatusCode(500) with error message on exception instead of Ok(empty)
SignalR lifecycle handlers are registered exactly once in getSignalRConnection, not per mount cycle
Frontend builds successfully with bun run build
verification: cd src/Nexus.Frontend && bun install && bun run build
